answer: Because the lagoon audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the dune bond on all of them and exposing each to the juniper slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 8 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A 275 account operation therefore ties up 39 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
